column1: # Single source of truth for packages. Read by BOTH install.sh (to install)
# and verify.sh (to check, and to auto-repair with --fix). Keeping one list
# means the two can never disagree about what the rice needs — the same
#   tier     base     the Sway WM stack itself
#            deps     things the rice's own configs/scripts invoke
#            hardware ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 enablement
#            integration  what YOUR already-installed apps need from sway
#            optional nice to have; absence is not a failure
#   provides the binary this package must put on PATH ("-" if it ships no
#            binary we call directly). verify.sh maps every `exec` target in
#            the generated keybinds.conf back through this column, so a
#            binding whose binary is missing is caught automatically.
# NOTE: no applications are listed here. VS Code, browsers and virt-manager
# are deliberately absent — those are yours to install and manage.
